title: Guarded developer toolchain and locked setup
author: Bijan Mousavi
why: Give contributors reproducible development inputs and reject setup mismatches before installation, while retaining the existing application and deployment interfaces.
what: Declare developer Node 24.21.0 and bundled npm 11.19.0. Add explicit doctor/install commands, seven focused tests and setup documentation. Installation delegates to npm ci.
how: Validate an isolated staged snapshot with the declared runtime. Replay both adapter builds, exercise real lock/version rejection, and check three built Node HTTP pages. All 491 locked Node engine constraints accept this version.
preserved: Application source, public assets, package manifest/lock, adapters, container startup, chart interfaces and CI remain byte-identical to the original application baseline. No automatic platform runtime override.
risk: An exact developer pin needs deliberate maintenance. macOS build success does not prove every platform or native dependency path. Install scripts and live-service build inputs still need review.
limitations: macOS arm64 only. No Linux, Windows, remote CI or deployment claim. npm warned about seven packages needing install-script approval. Inherited audit advisories remain. Report toolchain unchanged.
rollback: Revert the development declaration, bootstrap, tests and related guidance in a new reported commit. Existing npm entry points and deployment settings retain their original behavior.
